Insights & Learnings8
From methodologies
Font weight style names in Figma Plugin API vary per font family. Using the wrong format silently fails (renders as Regular) or throws a load error.
↳Figma Font Style Naming Is Inconsistent Across Familiescritical
Miro MCP's DSL-based diagram creation produces ~70% of the visual quality of hand-designed boards. Major gaps: no nested frames with numbering, limited spatial control, no custom color coding by role.
↳Miro MCP DSL Limitationsmedium
When creating a Notion database intended for use as a form (Notion Forms), the **property name** is displayed as the question text to respondents — NOT the description field.
↳Notion Forms Display Property Names as Questionscritical
PptxGenJS silently mutates the options objects passed to slide.addText() and similar methods. If you reuse an options object across multiple slides, later slides get corrupted values.
↳PptxGenJS Mutates Option Objectshigh
Vercel CLI requires browser-based OAuth authentication, which is not available in Cowork's sandboxed environment.
↳Vercel CLI Deploy Fails in Cowork (OAuth)medium
From meetings
Stage-Gate budget reviewed; outputs fed directly into Phase 1 Sync and unblocked the final client deck decision.
↳Budget + Stage Gate
Phase 1 green-lit by Ivan, Yegor, Anna; early signal for Phase 2 appetite — which became deal-piat-phase-2.
↳Phase 1 Sync: Updates & System Impact Review
From projects
Cascade Hypotheses v5.1 was canonized during this engagement — PiaT is the operational first of a generalizable framework.
↳PiaT IP Validation & Governance Model
